ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio (~45:55) between high-intensity light-grey/white central lobe regions and low-intensity black peduncle and peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region originating from peduncle; two high-intensity light-grey lobes with significant dark-pixel mottling; wide low-intensity band along trailing edge, significantly thicker on the right lobe (viewer's right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 45-degree angle with high vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern; significant pixel-depth peaks on the right lobe trailing edge; more moderate serration on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips; terminal points tilted dorsally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark circular clusters visible in the mid-region of the right lobe; dense textured dark-pixel clusters at both distal tips (likely barnacle colonization).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of multiple roughly parallel vertical dark linear marks (rake marks) on the upper mid-section of the right lobe; several faint diagonal lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation/notch on the outer-left fluke margin; significant dark textured masses at both fluke tips; pronounced vertical rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry; right lobe features a significantly thicker black trailing edge and more frequent focal dark spots compared to the left lobe.
